mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate level (FEDFUNDS) reflects accommodative monetary policy that reduces equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of economic regime.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of observations when FEDFUNDS is below 3.5% over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate increase above 4.0% signals aggressive monetary tightening, causing immediate equity sell-offs and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.0% over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days through earnings momentum.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS exceed their 12-month moving averages over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In low-unemployment regimes (UNRATE < 4.0%), accelerating nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signal labor market strength that boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in less than 40% of instances when PAYEMS rises >0.5% month-over-month in low-unemployment regimes (UNRATE < 4.0%) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A declining unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates tightening labor markets that support corporate profit growth, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of observations when UNRATE is below 4.0% over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 signals economic contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days due to reduced corporate activity.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO falls below 100.0 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent expansion in housing starts (HOUST) and real GDP (GDPC1) indicates broad-based economic strength, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through sustained corporate growth.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST and GDPC1 exceed their 12-month averages over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In low-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL < 330), a rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals premature monetary tightening that depresses equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in less than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises >0.25% in low-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL < 330) over any 3-year rolling window.
